entities.name: Minamoto no Yoshishige

entities.summary: Minamoto no Yoshishige  was the progenitor of the cadet Nitta branch family of the Minamoto samurai clan, who fought alongside the Minamoto in the Genpei War. He is also known as Nitta Tarō and Nitta Yoshishige.
